results.title: Amazing Spider-Man #1004 Details Itsy Bitsy Kidnapping of J. Jonah Jameson
results.description: Joe Kelly's Amazing Spider-Man 1004 releases on November 25, 2026. The issue follows Peter Parker's desperate rescue of J. Jonah Jameson from Itsy Bitsy while managing Avengers duties.

results.title: Bolton's Sophie Willan takes on heartfelt Christmas mission for BBC show
results.description: Bolton-born actress and comedian Sophie Willan is set to appear on BBC's The Repair Shop for a special Christmas episode close to her heart.

results.title: Have You Heard? Dia Mirza, Nawazuddin Siddiqui strike a pose after public spat
results.description: Dia Mirza and Nawazuddin Siddiqui's reunion comes a day after the actress called him a 'nightmare to work with' and an 'offensive character' in a social media post. Their sudden turnaround has raised eyebrows, with netizens questioning whether the public fallout was a publicity stunt.
